units.text: 快科技10月14日消息，苹果在2026年9月秋季发布会上仅推出了iPhone 18 Pro系列与首款折叠屏iPhone Duo，标准版iPhone 18并未亮相。
博主定焦数码披露，iPhone 18计划于11月底开始排产，该机和iPhone 18e将在2027年春季登场，而iPhone Air 2暂无消息。
对苹果来说，iPhone 18标准版延期背后有多重现实考量。首要原因是产能与成本的双重挤压，iPhone 18 Pro系列首发台积电2nm芯片A20 Pro，新工艺初期产能与良率有限，苹果需要优先保障利润更高的Pro系列供应，以避免标准版争夺有限的组装资源。
内存价格持续暴涨也是关键因素，DRAM与NAND现货价格在过去两个季度累计涨幅超过300%，对于出货量庞大的iPhone来说，哪怕单颗元件价格微涨，累积到数百万台也会显著冲击整机利润。
将标准版延后，既能分散对内存等元件的集中需求，也能给供应链留出调整采购配置的空间。硬件配置上，iPhone 18有望搭载A20芯片，其运行内存从8GB升级至9GB，并预装iOS 27系统。
不过，由于内存配置的限制，iPhone 18标准版的AI体验与Pro系列可能会存在一定差异。值得关注的是，苹果官网iPhone 17起售价已涨至6799元，iPhone 17e起售价涨至5299元。
作为迭代旗舰，iPhone 18e和iPhone 18的起售价分别不低于5299元和6799元，整体定价门槛进一步抬高。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，科技媒体 uploadvr 昨日（10 月 14 日）发布博文，报道称 苹果 Vision Pro 头显用户可以通过最新作品，沉浸式体验好莱坞私人魔术俱乐部“魔术城堡”（The Magic Castle）。 IT之家援引博文介绍，魔术城堡是位于好莱坞的私人魔术俱乐部，同时是魔术艺术学院的所在地。该场所通常仅接待会员和受邀者，以近景魔术、舞台魔术及魔术文化交流闻名。 报道称沉浸式视频作品《You Are Here: At the Magic Castle with Siegfried Tieber》现已登陆 Apple Vision Pro，该作品由魔术师 Siegfried Tieber 主演，以现场录制的沉浸式视频形式呈现魔术表演。 该体验分为 2 个独立片段，每集约 20 分钟，合计约 40 分钟，内容涵盖近景魔术与心灵感应表演，观众可在近景魔术廊和图书馆酒吧两个场景观看表演。 以上图源：视频截图 该作品现已向 Fovii 订阅用户免费开放，用户也可在应用内租赁或购买。此外，作品已在 Front Row 平台提供购买选项。除表演外，作品还融入魔术历史、魔术城堡背景及魔术师职业体验等叙事内容。观众可通过环视画面，查看自己感兴趣的细节。 科技媒体 uploadvr 昨日（10 月 14 日）发布博文，报道称苹果 Vision Pro 头显用户可以通过最新作品，沉浸式体验好莱坞私人魔术俱乐部“魔术城堡”（The Magic Castle）。

evidence.discovery_lead: Bünyamin Aydın brought together Turkish heritage, rock influences, and futurism for a landmark fashion show in Cappadocia shot on iPhone 18 Pro Max.
evidence.discovery_title: Bünyamin Aydın’s new collection, “From Earth to Sky,” soars with iPad Pro
evidence.raw_lead: Bünyamin Aydın brought together Turkish heritage, rock influences, and futurism for a landmark fashion show in Cappadocia shot on iPhone 18 Pro Max.
evidence.title: Bünyamin Aydın’s new collection, “From Earth to Sky,” soars with iPad Pro

units.text: Long before the sun rises in Cappadocia, Türkiye’s Rose Valley is already awake. Crews are on the move, models refresh their makeup, and three giant hot-air balloons — neon green, yellow, and pink — float above a landscape that looks like it belongs on Mars. The scene is set for Les Benjamins designer Bünyamin Aydın’s most ambitious project yet. “From Earth to Sky” celebrates 15 years of the Istanbul-based lifestyle brand and brings together Anatolian heritage, avant-garde design, and the magic of iPad Pro with Apple Pencil Pro. Shot on iPhone 18 Pro Max by French filmmaker Neels Castillon, this fashion show is like no other. The project began to take shape during a research trip to Cappadocia in early 2026. Aydın used iPad Pro and Apple Pencil Pro, alongside iPhone 17 Pro Max to record the extraordinary terrain, shooting photographs and 4K video at 60 fps.
Native flowers Bünyamin Aydın encountered in Cappadocia, Türkiye’s Rose Valley became the heart of his latest collection, inspiring 10 striking looks and three custom-built hot-air balloons.
Native flowers Bünyamin Aydın encountered in Cappadocia, Türkiye’s Rose Valley became the heart of his latest collection, inspiring 10 striking looks and three custom-built hot-air balloons.

Aydın’s creative process seldom takes place behind a desk, so he appreciates the flexibility iPad Pro offers with its thin, light form factor and battery life that can last him up to two days. “It’s the ultimate workstation on the go,” Aydın says. “That gives me freedom.” Three native flowers he encountered in the region — spiky green Echinops, flutelike pink trumpets, and wild yellow tulips — became the heart of this latest collection, inspiring 10 striking looks and three custom-built hot-air balloons. For Aydın, Les Benjamins represents the intersection of people and their cultures, and “From Earth to Sky” is no different. Born in Germany, the designer was raised with what he describes as “German discipline and Turkish heart” — a duality that runs through his work. “The canvas is the West; the paint is the East,” he says of a collection that combines contemporary silhouettes with Turkish fabrics and Silk Road influences. iPad Pro with the powerful M5 chip became the creative nexus for the entire project. After research trips, Aydın would assemble photographs, fabric references, and early designs in the Freeform app, where evolving mood boards could be easily shared or exported to keep work ticking along. “Freeform allowed me to bring my team into my creative journey instead of simply giving them finished ideas,” he says. The multitasking features on iPad Pro became integral as the workflows multiplied. Aydın could use its intuitive windowing system to work on an active sketch in Procreate, refer to photos from his travels, and research local flora in Safari, all while Background Tasks exported files for his collaborators. And then there were the hot-air balloons. Working in Procreate, Aydın and his team designed a single structure as a starting point, then rapidly duplicated, altered, and redrew it until three final forms emerged from dozens of variations. To bring the designs to life, Aydın collaborated with Pasha Balloons, one of Cappadocia’s hot-air balloon pioneers. “I would send my sketches to them, and they would use their engineering know-how to make sure they could actually fly,” he says with a smile. These technical drawings would then go straight back into Procreate for review and refinement. Finding the right colors was vital. In addition to the electric hues of the balloons, Aydın also worked with cream, blue, and natural tones. “These are the colors of the earth and the sky,” he explains. The Ultra Retina XDR display on iPad Pro — which uses tandem OLED technology — became a key tool, while True Tone helped Aydın achieve the saturation he wanted, regardless of ambient lighting. Apple Pencil Pro helped draw the line from idea to iterative design. “Working with regular pen and paper feels very natural, but the hover feature on Apple Pencil Pro lets me preview every stroke before I even make it, so I can see any mistakes beforehand,” he says. “It’s like a supernatural tool.” An avid gamer, Aydın compares his relationship with Apple Pencil Pro to the muscle memory he developed while playing his favorite titles. Squeezing, double-tapping, and switching to the eraser now feel like reflexive actions, which enabled him to move quickly through variations without the tool interrupting the idea. And the low latency made the creative experience feel more immersive and responsive than ever. “We were working on high-resolution images, creating multiple layers and playing with textures. That’s usually when things start to slow down,” he says. “But that never happened on iPad Pro. It felt just like working on a desktop.” Back in Rose Valley, months of planning and work are finally coming to life. Even before the sun touches the horizon, Castillon’s iPhone 18 Pro Max is already rolling. Three runways, gigantic hot-air balloons, and natural light that continues to change with every passing minute mean there is little room for error. The new 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture allows Castillon to begin filming in low light before narrowing the aperture as the sun comes up. Camera operators use Pro controls like histogram and white balance to keep the look consistent across multiple cameras as the sky changes from pink to blue. Working with iPhone 18 Pro Max brings the immediacy Castillon loves as a director. “When I see something beautiful, I want to film it right away,” he says. The A20 Pro chip and improved thermal management also give the production the sustained performance and reliability it needs to capture heavy 4K video throughout the event. Just as Aydın’s show travels from past to future, movement drives Castillon’s visual treatment. Custom-built drones each carry two iPhone 18 Pro Max models, with their 48MP Fusion Ultra Wide cameras focused on enhancing the sense of vertiginous speed while fitting the massive balloons into frame. Footage captured at 4K 120 fps allows Castillon to highlight elements like rippling fabric in cinematic slow motion, while a slower shutter speed turns quick drone passes into a painterly impressionistic motion blur. Castillon’s treatment also creates a dreamlike, psychedelic look. He uses ProRes RAW to preserve flexibility for color grading in post-production, as Cappadocia’s pale hues meet saturated pinks, yellows, and greens. “I’m a huge nerd for color, and the tones are really accurate on iPad Pro,” he says. While his team records video, Castillon shoots stills with the 48MP Fusion Main camera, using the new texture and grain controls in Photographic Styles 3 to bring some of the tactile character he loves in analog photography into the images. As feeds from the whirling drones come into Castillon’s production control center, synchronizing them begins right there on location. He reviews footage and makes selections on MacBook Pro with M4 Max; its nano-texture display helps reduce glare from the sun overhead. With the performance in full swing, Castillon’s focus switches from crane to drone to capture the opening look: a Turkish caftan and a tree branch representing Anatolia, an homage to Turkish rock icon Barış Manço. The show’s scale is huge, but Aydın believes its potential is larger still. For him, “From Earth to Sky” is a chance to bring Turkish culture to a global audience without losing sight of its roots. “I see my role as that of a translator and a bridge between East and West,” Aydın says. “I hope this project makes Turkish people proud.” “From Earth to Sky” was shot on iPhone 18 Pro Max. Check it out on @apple beginning October 14.

evidence.discovery_lead: The "Hatfield" Apple-1 has sold for $1,148,200 including the buyer's premium, setting a world auction record for a commercially sold Apple-1, according to Bonhams. Two bidders competed for 28 minutes before the October 14 auction closed, taking the working computer beyond its $500,000 to $800,000 estimate. The machine takes its name from original owner Fred Hatfield, who complained to Apple about the lack of software for the Apple-1. A letter included in the sale contains Steve Jobs' 1978 reply, offering an Apple II motherboard in exchange for the Apple-1 and another $400. Hatfield kept his computer. He eventually sold it privately for $40,000 while it needed repairs. The buyer restored it and obtained Steve Wozniak's signature on the motherboard before it set an auction record in 2013. Bonhams lists that earlier sale as approximately $686,000.

units.text: 在苹果公司迎来成立50周年之际，一台极为罕见且仍能正常工作的Apple I电脑以115万美元的价格成功拍出，刷新了Apple I系列产品的拍卖纪录。这台机器不仅由苹果联合创始人史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克亲笔签名，还附带了一封史蒂夫·乔布斯当年写给原机主的信件，因此吸引了收藏界的高度关注。
Apple I作为苹果历史上的首款产品，近年来收藏价值持续攀升。过去十年间，该机型的市场价值显著增长。此前曾有Apple I电脑以接近50万美元的价格成交，远高于当时约30万美元的预估价。
此次创下纪录的这台设备被称为“Hatfield Apple I”。原机主弗雷德·哈特菲尔德当年以666.60美元的售价购入该电脑。早在2013年，欧洲拍卖行Breker曾以约66.6万美元的价格拍出这台机器，当时已经引起广泛关注。
2026年9月，这台历史悠久的电脑在美国多个地点进行了公开展示。随后在邦瀚斯拍卖行举行的拍卖会上，它最终以115万美元成交，成为迄今为止价格最高的Apple I。整场竞拍过程仅持续28分钟，竞争主要集中在两名竞标者之间。
邦瀚斯北美精品书籍与手稿部门主管伊恩·埃林表示，这一结果令人振奋。他认为，“Hatfield Apple I”是计算机历史上最重要的里程碑之一，而能够在苹果成立50周年这一特殊年份拍卖苹果首款产品，也具有特殊纪念意义。
埃林指出，这台电脑是进入市场拍卖的Apple I当中最重要的实例之一，激烈的竞价过程充分体现了其罕见程度以及长期以来在收藏市场上的吸引力。
根据Apple I注册档案，这台电脑编号为48号。它之所以格外特殊，不仅是因为保存状态良好、能够正常运行，还因为主板上保留了史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克的亲笔签名。此外，机器还附带了一封史蒂夫·乔布斯写给哈特菲尔德的信件。信中乔布斯曾建议他以现有Apple I及400美元作为折价，换购Apple II的主板。
事实上，这并非唯一一台获得沃兹尼亚克签名的Apple I。2022年，一台经过修复的Apple I曾由沃兹尼亚克在中央处理器芯片上签名，并最终以34.01万美元成交。
近年来，Apple I的拍卖价格普遍维持在30万至50万美元区间。2025年3月，一台能够正常运行的Apple I以37.5万美元成交；同年9月，另一台保留原始木制外壳的Apple I则拍出了47.5万美元。
收藏家愿意为Apple I支付高昂价格并不令人意外。作为苹果公司历史上的第一款计算机产品，Apple I由史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克于1976年设计，是苹果发展历程的起点。从某种意义上说，如果没有Apple I的诞生，后来风靡全球的Mac电脑以及苹果庞大的产品生态体系都可能不会出现。因此，这款电脑不仅是一件电子产品，更被视为个人计算机发展史上的重要见证。

units.text: Apple says HomeView is “the perfect way” to enjoy its audio and video entertainment apps, but some notable examples like Apple TV only work if you AirPlay it through your iPhone. As noted on the HomeView spec page, Apple TV, Apple Books audiobooks, Apple Music Classical, and Apple News Plus aren’t natively supported on the smart hub, so you’ll have to use your phone to operate them.

HomeView is foremostly designed as a hub for managing smart home gadgets, but competing smart display hardware like Amazon’s Echo Show and Google’s Nest Hub devices can natively stream Prime Video and YouTube, respectively, without requiring a phone connection. Apple TV is also featured in at least one promotional image for HomeView, but the AirPlay requirement is in small print on its announcement page:
> “Subscription may be required to access some content and services. Some applications are not available in all areas. Select apps require a paired and compatible iPhone nearby.”
> [Image: These are the app limitations flagged on Apple’s HomeView spec page. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Apple-HomeView-supported-apps.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

We have reached out to Apple for more information on why HomeView doesn’t natively support Apple TV, Apple Books audiobooks, Apple Music Classical, and Apple News Plus, and if that may change in the future.
[Media: https://twitter.com/vistar941/status/2110233672737824982]

The hardware itself certainly isn’t a limitation — HomeView runs on Apple’s A18 chip, the same processor that powers an iPhone 16. Its software functions more like CarPlay than iOS, iPadOS, or even Apple TV, since, like CarPlay, it requires a connected iPhone for many functions. The HomeView also doesn’t have an App Store (which is typical for smart home hubs), which makes that CarPlay connection even more significant for third-party app developers, since apps that support projecting video or audio through the platform will work easily from day one.
“Subscription may be required to access some content and services. Some applications are not available in all areas. Select apps require a paired and compatible iPhone nearby.”

evidence.discovery_lead: There's been some confusion about which of Apple's new and existing home devices will support Siri AI and when, because ‌Siri‌ AI isn't going to be available at launch on some products. Devices With Siri AI HomeView - Available at launch (November 13) Apple TV 4K (4th generation) - Available at launch (November 13) Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) - Available in tvOS 27.2 Apple TV 4K (2nd generation) - Available in tvOS 27.2 HomePod mini 2 - Ships October 30, ‌Siri‌ AI coming in a future software update Despite a report from CNET suggesting the first HomePod mini would support Siri AI , Apple has since confirmed that's not the case. No Siri AI Support Original HomePod mini Original HomePod Original Apple TV 4K (no tvOS 27) Apple TV HD (no tvOS 27) Unconfirmed HomePod 2 - Possibly coming, with mentions in website metadata Siri AI Requirements On the ‌HomePod‌ and Apple TV 4K models that support ‌Siri‌ AI, the home owner in the Home app must have an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad on the latest version of the software. ‌Siri‌ AI has to be turned on, and it has to be set to a supported language. Other members of the household don't need an Apple Intelligence-enabled device once ‌Siri‌ AI is turned on, except for personal requests. HomeView does not require an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or ‌iPad‌ for ‌Siri‌ AI, except for requests that use personal context. ‌Siri‌ AI for HomeView, ‌Apple TV‌ 4K, and HomePod mini 2 is English only and is limited to the United States, Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and the UK at launch. EU Restrictions ‌Siri‌ AI is not available in the EU on the iPhone and ‌iPad‌, so ‌Siri‌ AI won't be available for home devices that support it. HomeView isn't even launching in the EU. Siri AI Beta Apple is still calling ‌Siri‌ AI a beta, and it will be in beta when it's available on HomeView, ‌Apple TV‌ 4K, and ‌HomePod mini 2‌. units.text: Which Apple Home Devices Get Siri AI, and When
There's been some confusion about which of Apple's new and existing home devices will support Siri AI and when, because ‌Siri‌ AI isn't going to be available at launch on some products.
Devices With Siri AI
HomeView - Available at launch (November 13)
Apple TV 4K (4th generation) - Available at launch (November 13)
Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) - Available in tvOS 27.2
Apple TV 4K (2nd generation) - Available in tvOS 27.2
HomePod mini 2 - Ships October 30, ‌Siri‌ AI coming in a future software update
Despite a report from CNET suggesting the first HomePod mini would support Siri AI, Apple has since confirmed that's not the case.
No Siri AI Support
Original HomePod mini
Original HomePod
Original Apple TV 4K (no tvOS 27)
Apple TV HD (no tvOS 27)
Unconfirmed
HomePod 2 - Possibly coming, with mentions in website metadata
Siri AI Requirements

On the ‌HomePod‌ and Apple TV 4K models that support ‌Siri‌ AI, the home owner in the Home app must have an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad on the latest version of the software. ‌Siri‌ AI has to be turned on, and it has to be set to a supported language. Other members of the household don't need an Apple Intelligence-enabled device once ‌Siri‌ AI is turned on, except for personal requests.
HomeView does not require an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or ‌iPad‌ for ‌Siri‌ AI, except for requests that use personal context.
‌Siri‌ AI for HomeView, ‌Apple TV‌ 4K, and HomePod mini 2 is English only and is limited to the United States, Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and the UK at launch.
EU Restrictions
‌Siri‌ AI is not available in the EU on the iPhone and ‌iPad‌, so ‌Siri‌ AI won't be available for home devices that support it. HomeView isn't even launching in the EU.
Siri AI Beta
Apple is still calling ‌Siri‌ AI a beta, and it will be in beta when it's available on HomeView, ‌Apple TV‌ 4K, and ‌HomePod mini 2‌.

evidence.discovery_title: Apple HomeView Includes Temperature and Humidity Sensors
evidence.raw_lead: Apple's new HomeView includes temperature and humidity sensing, allowing the smart home hub to monitor indoor conditions and supply readings to the new thermostats developed with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric. Apple's technical specifications confirm that both the tabletop and wall-mounted HomeView have a temperature and humidity sensor. The hardware is listed alongside the ambient light sensor and accelerometer. There are several limitations for the HomeView's readings.
evidence.title: Apple HomeView Includes Temperature and Humidity Sensors

units.text: Apple HomeView Includes Temperature and Humidity Sensors

Apple's new HomeView includes temperature and humidity sensing, allowing the smart home hub to monitor indoor conditions and supply readings to the new thermostats developed with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric.

Apple's technical specifications confirm that both the tabletop and wall-mounted HomeView have a temperature and humidity sensor. The hardware is listed alongside the ambient light sensor and accelerometer.

There are several limitations for the HomeView's readings. Temperature and humidity sensing is optimized for indoor domestic environments with ambient temperatures around 59°F to 86°F, and relative humidity around 30% to 70%.
Accuracy may decrease when HomeView plays audio at high volume for an extended period. The sensors also require time to calibrate immediately after startup before results appear.

According to Apple, the LG and Schneider Electric thermostats in the "Apple Home Collection" can obtain temperature and humidity readings from multiple rooms using sensors built into HomeView, HomePod, and ‌HomePod‌ mini, as well as dedicated sensors from either manufacturer. The thermostats also support Adaptive Temperature in the Home app, which uses on-device intelligence from iPhone to adjust settings based on whether someone is home, winding down for the night, or away.

LG's Temperature Sensor and the Schneider Home Room Sensor will each start at $39.95 in the United States, while the companies' thermostats will each start at $199.95. Both HomeView models cost $299 in the United States and launch on November 13.

evidence.raw_lead: 10月15日，iPhoneDuo维修价格出炉。苹果官网显示，iPhoneDuo的内屏损坏预估服务费用高达人民币7998元，这一价格相当于一款顶配Android旗舰直板机的价格，甚至可以购买一台普通的折叠旗舰手机。
evidence.title: iPhone Duo维修价格出炉 能买一台普通折叠旗舰手机了 - Apple iPhone - cnBeta.COM

units.text: 10月15日，iPhone Duo维修价格出炉。苹果官网显示，iPhone Duo的内屏损坏预估服务费用高达人民币7998元，这一价格相当于一款顶配Android旗舰直板机的价格，甚至可以购买一台普通的折叠旗舰手机。
其他部件方面，iPhone Duo外屏和背面玻璃损坏的预估服务费用为4298元，外屏损坏费用为3198元，后置相机损坏费用为1798元，背面玻璃损坏费用为1598元，表层损坏费用为398元。此外，电池更换则刷新iPhone历史纪录，达1898元。
值得注意的是，在AppleCare+服务下，iPhone Duo的维修费用大幅度降低。内屏损坏费用降至628元，外屏损坏、背面玻璃损坏和表层损坏分别降至188元、188元、139元，电池服务费用则直接降至0元。
作为苹果首款折叠屏手机，iPhone Duo采用左右内折设计，合拢后外屏为5.4英寸，展开后是一块7.6英寸Super Retina XDR屏幕。苹果称，内屏面积比iPhone 18 Pro Max大50%，超过iPhone 18 Pro的80%。
苹果称，Duo内屏由十层超薄结构组成，使用纳米纹理表面降低反光，层与层之间的光学透明黏合材料可以在折叠时产生微小滑动，以降低应力和折痕。

units.text: 快科技10月15日消息，等待两年多，国行Apple Intelligence（苹果智能）终于迎来了新的上线时间表。
据知名科技记者马克·古尔曼报道，苹果计划今年12月通过iOS 27.3更新，正式在中国大陆推出首批Apple Intelligence功能。
不过，首批上线的主要是苹果2024年推出的基础AI功能，今年发布的新版Siri AI暂时不会向中国用户开放。
据了解，首批功能预计涵盖AI通知摘要、写作工具、照片消除等，个性化表情符号生成功能Genmoji也有望上线，但部分新功能将受到限制。
苹果自研的AI图像生成工具Image Playground预计无缘首批上线，部分应用中的AI文本生成功能也将受到限制。
事实上，国行苹果智能的上线时间此前已多次推迟。
苹果最初计划于2025年5月在中国推出Apple Intelligence，随后将时间推迟至2025年底，此后又调整至2026年春季，如今最新目标已变为今年12月。
据了解，苹果早在2024年就推出了Apple Intelligence，并于同年10月随iOS 18.1更新向海外用户开放首批功能，但国行版本迟迟未能落地。
值得注意的是，在苹果智能迟迟未能入华的这段时间里，华为、小米、OPPO、vivo等国产手机厂商早已将AI助手、AI修图、智能写作等功能应用于旗下产品，并不断强化系统级AI体验。
相比之下，苹果此次计划在国内推出的首批AI功能，大多已在海外市场上线近两年。
目前，苹果尚未正式公布国行Apple Intelligence的具体上线日期，能否在今年12月随iOS 27.3如期推出，仍有待官方确认。

units.text: The Apple Invites app got updated yet again today, with new features including RSVP improvements and a larger Home Screen widget. Here are the details.
Apple Invites gets new update

Just two weeks after gaining full-resolution photo sharing and new Image Playground capabilities, the Apple Invites app got updated yet again today, with improvements to guest management and Home Screen widgets.
With today’s update, the app can now leverage the new extra-large widget introduced with iOS 27, and makes it easier to track RSVPs.
Here’s Apple’s the full release notes for Apple Invites v 1.12.1:
Hosts can now more easily manually add guests to the event and mark their RSVP status, so your guest list stays accurate even when someone confirms outside the app.
Invites widget now supports the extra large size to give you more options to countdown on your Home Screen.
This update contains bug fixes and performance improvements.

units.text: 快科技10月15日消息，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo将于10月16日开启预购，10月23日正式发售，新机的性能表现也提前揭晓。
日前，iPhone Duo现身Geekbench 7跑分平台，单核成绩3986分，多核成绩11067分，整体表现与iPhone 18 Pro系列基本处于同一水平。
根据Geekbench数据库信息，此次参与测试的设备型号为iPhone19,4，运行iOS 27.1系统，搭载苹果最新A20 Pro芯片。
该芯片采用6核心CPU设计，包括2颗性能核心和4颗能效核心，最高主频达到4.93GHz，与iPhone 18 Pro系列保持一致。
内存方面，Geekbench识别到的容量为11.30GB，对应实际12GB运行内存。
据了解，iPhone Duo与iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max均搭载A20 Pro芯片，采用台积电2nm工艺打造。
苹果表示，A20 Pro相比上一代A19 Pro，CPU性能最高提升20%，GPU性能最高提升40%。
从目前曝光的跑分来看，iPhone Duo的成绩虽然略低于部分iPhone 18 Pro系列机型，但整体差距不大。
需要注意的是，目前仅有一组iPhone Duo跑分成绩曝光，单次测试结果存在一定波动，尚不能代表新机的最终性能表现。
此外，由于iPhone Duo采用折叠屏设计，内部空间和散热结构与传统直板旗舰有所不同，其持续性能释放仍有待实际测试。
作为苹果首款折叠屏手机，iPhone Duo采用横向内折设计，配备5.4英寸外屏和7.6英寸内屏，国行售价15999元起。

units.text: Apple has just updated its list of vintage and obsolete products, adding the final model of the beloved 12-inch MacBook to the “obsolete” list alongside two other products.
All 12-inch MacBook models are now obsolete, as iPad 6 and BeatsX join list too
Today Apple marked three additional products as “obsolete” on its website.
The company keeps a public list of vintage and obsolete products here. It’s regularly updated with new additions based on how long ago a product stopped being available for purchase.
Essentially, if a product stopped being on sale from Apple 5 or more years ago, it’s considered “vintage.” This means Apple will still service the product, but parts availability may be limited.
If a product stopped being sold 7 or more years ago, it’s marked “obsolete.” Obsolete products are no longer eligible for repairs or any other servicing from Apple.
The latest obsolete products include:
MacBook (Retina, 12-inch, 2017)
iPad (6th generation) in Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi + Cellular models
BeatsX in a variety of colors, including Burned Red, Defiant Black-Red, Deep Black, Pure White, and Sky Blue
If you own any of these products, Apple will no longer be able to service them.
View all comments
The most notable addition is the MacBook, as the 2017 model is the last one Apple produced before the line was discontinued. The 2015 and 2016 models were already on the obsolete list.
While the 12-inch MacBook was pitched by Apple as a type of MacBook Air successor, it never took off with consumers despite having a loyal base of fans who loved it.
Are you still running any of these products? Let us know in the comments.
*Buy Mac with 15% discount from Apple refurbished

units.text: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，苹果董事会执行主席蒂姆 · 库克今日在上海接受澎湃新闻、界面新闻等媒体采访时确认，苹果智能（Apple Intelligence）及相关阿里千问大模型已获得批准，将于 10 月晚些时候面向中国用户发布测试版本。
库克表示，首批功能包括实时翻译、书写工具、照片清除工具等，但 Siri AI 不在此次发布范围之内。“我们很高兴，首批核心的苹果智能功能是可以慢慢上线了。”库克说道。
IT之家此前报道，此次获批涉及的阿里系模型包括通义千问和通义万相，前者为大语言模型，后者为图像及视频生成工具。
彭博社古尔曼还曾报道称，苹果计划于 12 月随 iOS 27.3 系统更新为中国用户正式推送 Apple Intelligence，首批功能与 2024 年海外首次发布时的版本基本一致。
同日，商务部部长王文涛会见了库克，双方就中美经贸关系、人工智能发展、苹果公司在华业务等议题进行交流。王文涛表示，中方倡导人工智能发展安全可控、普惠向善、治理合作，希望苹果公司发挥沟通桥梁作用，为推动中美经贸关系持续稳定向好发展贡献力量。库克表示，苹果公司看好中国发展前景，将进一步扩大在华业务。

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple's use of CarPlay APIs for the HomeView is a strange compromise, is putting developers in a tough spot, and there's good reason to question how useful it will be. It won't look like this, but HomeView will run CarPlay apps - image credit: Apple You're not likely to need any of the dozens of parking apps that litter the App Store on your HomeView. And presumably you'll never need to access your car's app, but there may be some interesting use cases there, depending. But beyond that, there is more. It's tempting to say there is a world of possible CarPlay apps that are suddenly able to run on HomeView. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple is reportedly preparing a substantial production run for the standard iPhone 18 , following the iPhone 17 's success as the world's best-selling smartphone. In a new Weibo post , the leaker known as " Fixed Focus Digital " claimed that production of the standard ‌iPhone 18‌ is scheduled to start in late November, describing the volume of inventory being prepared as "quite large." Its predecessor has likely given Apple considerable reason for confidence. Following the ‌iPhone 17‌'s initial pre-order weekend, Apple reportedly instructed two suppliers to increase daily output by at least 30% , according to The Information . Counterpoint Research later reported that the standard ‌iPhone 17‌ led global smartphone sales in both the first and second quarters of 2026. It accounted for 6% of worldwide smartphone unit sales in each quarter, outselling even the ‌iPhone 17‌ Pro Max and ‌iPhone 17‌ Pro. The ‌iPhone 18‌ is expected to retain a broadly similar design, with potential upgrades including a smaller Dynamic Island , the A20 chip , and Apple's C2 modem. It is expected to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18e and iPhone Air 2 in spring 2027 . A late-November production start would give Apple several months to build inventory ahead of launch. units.text: Apple Reportedly Planning Large iPhone 18 Production Run
Apple is reportedly preparing a substantial production run for the standard iPhone 18, following the iPhone 17's success as the world's best-selling smartphone.

In a new Weibo post, the leaker known as "Fixed Focus Digital" claimed that production of the standard ‌iPhone 18‌ is scheduled to start in late November, describing the volume of inventory being prepared as "quite large."

Its predecessor has likely given Apple considerable reason for confidence. Following the ‌iPhone 17‌'s initial pre-order weekend, Apple reportedly instructed two suppliers to increase daily output by at least 30%, according to The Information. Counterpoint Research later reported that the standard ‌iPhone 17‌ led global smartphone sales in both the first and second quarters of 2026. It accounted for 6% of worldwide smartphone unit sales in each quarter, outselling even the ‌iPhone 17‌ Pro Max and ‌iPhone 17‌ Pro.

The ‌iPhone 18‌ is expected to retain a broadly similar design, with potential upgrades including a smaller Dynamic Island, the A20 chip, and Apple's C2 modem. It is expected to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18e and iPhone Air 2 in spring 2027. A late-November production start would give Apple several months to build inventory ahead of launch.

units.text: 快科技10月15日消息，iPhone Duo将于10月16日开启预售，起售价为15999元，仅提供夜空色和星光白两款配色。作为苹果首款折叠屏手机，它的维修成本也备受关注。
日前，苹果官网已经提前公布了维修价格。其中，非AppleCare+用户更换一块内屏需要7998元，几乎相当于一款顶配安卓旗舰。评论区不少网友直呼“iPhone Duo修不起”，认为维修费用太高。
对此，苹果客服表示，一是iPhone Duo使用钛金属材质，造价及其他方面有更高要求；二是iPhone Duo屏幕制造工艺也有明显改善，表层采用了纳米纹理。电池方面，iPhone Duo内含两块电池，电池维修操作难度会更高，相应维修报价也更高。
客服还表示，若消费者担忧iPhone Duo维修预估费用过高，可选择购买AppleCare+服务。AppleCare+用户更换内屏的预估费用为628元，相比之下可以大幅降低维修负担。
硬件配置上，iPhone Duo拥有7.6英寸内屏以及5.4英寸外屏，双屏均支持120Hz ProMotion自适应刷新率，核心搭载A20 Pro芯片，后置4800万双摄，整机重量254克，仅提供eSIM网络。
该机由富士康负责组装，整机量产良率仅六成出头，远低于常规iPhone 90%以上的水准，量产进度持续受阻，短期内很难实现大规模量产。也正因如此，首销当天在黄牛渠道大概率会溢价销售。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，苹果公司昨日（10 月 14 日）发布公告，宣布携手潮牌 Les Benjamins， 在土耳其卡帕多奇亚（Cappadocia）的玫瑰谷（Rose Valley）上演名为“From Earth to Sky”（从大地到天空）的时装秀。 IT之家注：Les Benjamins 成立于 2011 年，由设计师 Bünyamin Aydın 创立，起初以印花 T 恤起家，如今已发展为涵盖男装、女装、卫衣、运动套装、外套、牛仔及生活方式产品的品牌。本次时装秀也是为了庆祝该品牌成立 15 周年。 在本次时装秀期间，最亮眼的是 3 个翱翔于峡谷上空的巨型热气球，由 Aydın 借助 iPad Pro 搭配 Apple Pencil Pro 在 Procreate 软件中绘制完成的。 Aydın 透露，Apple Pencil Pro 的“悬停预览”（Hover）功能就像一件“超自然工具”，让他能在落笔前规避错误，完美将安纳托利亚的本地花卉转化为巨型飞行艺术装置的技术图纸。 除了通过 iPad 设计巨型热气球外，苹果公司还表示在本次活动中，全程使用 iPhone 18 Pro Max 拍摄记录。法国知名导演 Neels Castillon 全程使用 iPhone 18 Pro Max 掌镜记录了整场大秀，海外科技媒体称 这是苹果秋季发布会（国内数码爱好者戏称为苹果科技春晚）后，iPhone 18 Pro Max 的首场顶级实战。 得益于 iPhone 18 Pro Max 的 可变光圈技术与强劲的 A20 Pro 芯片 ，摄制组在日光剧烈变化的环境下实现了平滑的画面过渡，并利用特制无人机搭载手机，完成了 4K 120fps ProRes RAW 的高难度电影级慢动作航拍。 以上图源：苹果 苹果公司昨日（10 月 14 日）发布公告，宣布携手潮牌 Les Benjamins，在土耳其卡帕多奇亚（Cappadocia）的玫瑰谷（Rose Valley）上演名为“From Earth to Sky”（从大地到天空）的高空时装秀。

units.text: 苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo即将正式开售。在产品预购启动前，这款新机已经出现在Geekbench 7性能测试数据库中。初步跑分显示，iPhone Duo的CPU性能与搭载同款A20 Pro芯片的iPhone 18 Pro系列基本处于同一水平，单核得分为3986分，多核得分为11067分。此外，测试信息还显示，该机配备12GB运行内存，运行iOS 27.1系统。
这意味着，苹果并没有因为iPhone Duo采用折叠屏设计，就明显降低其处理器配置。从目前公布的测试结果来看，这款手机在CPU计算能力方面能够达到苹果旗舰直板手机的水平。不过，由于目前只有一组测试成绩，尚不足以全面判断其持续性能、图形处理能力以及长时间运行大型游戏时的实际表现。
这次出现在Geekbench数据库中的设备型号标识为iPhone19，4，运行系统为iOS 27.1。测试结果显示，其单核成绩为3986分，多核成绩为11067分。相关成绩与此前出现的多组iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max测试结果大致相符。
iPhone Duo采用苹果最新的A20 Pro处理器。这款芯片采用2纳米制造工艺，配备六核心CPU和七核心GPU。由于iPhone 18 Pro系列同样使用A20 Pro，因此两款产品在处理器的基本配置上保持一致。
从CPU频率信息来看，测试记录显示其处理器频率约为4.93GHz，与此前iPhone 18 Pro系列跑分中出现的频率信息一致。这进一步表明，iPhone Duo采用的并非经过明显降频处理的特殊版本芯片。
内存方面，Geekbench记录显示设备具有约11.30GB可用内存，对应的标称运行内存容量为12GB。对于一款采用双屏设计的折叠屏手机而言，较大的内存容量有助于系统同时维持多个应用程序的运行状态，并为多任务处理提供空间。
iPhone Duo的双屏设计是其区别于传统iPhone的重要特征。根据苹果此前公布的信息，该机配备一块5.4英寸外屏，展开后则可以使用7.6英寸内屏。更大的显示区域能够为分屏操作、多窗口应用以及视频和游戏提供更多空间，但也可能增加系统在某些使用场景下的资源需求。
苹果为A20 Pro设定的性能目标同样相当激进。公司表示，与上一代A19 Pro相比，A20 Pro的CPU性能最高提升20%，GPU性能最高提升40%。不过，此次Geekbench测试主要衡量CPU性能，并没有提供GPU跑分，因此不能单凭这组数据验证苹果关于图形性能提升40%的说法。
Geekbench的单核测试主要反映处理器执行单线程任务的能力，而多核测试则更侧重多个CPU核心协同处理任务时的表现。这些指标能够帮助用户初步了解芯片的计算能力，但并不能完整代表手机的综合性能。
例如，手机在运行大型游戏时，除了CPU性能，还会受到GPU计算能力、内存带宽、游戏优化以及散热系统的影响。对于折叠屏设备而言，屏幕尺寸、显示内容和运行时间也可能改变整机的功耗和温度表现。因此，即使iPhone Duo与iPhone 18 Pro在短时间CPU测试中取得相近成绩，两款手机在长时间高负载运行时仍可能表现不同。
散热是其中一个值得关注的因素。iPhone Duo采用双屏折叠结构，其内部空间布局与传统直板手机存在差异。设备在长时间运行高负载应用时，处理器产生的热量需要通过内部散热结构传导和释放。如果温度达到系统设定的限制，设备可能降低处理器频率，以控制发热和功耗，这通常被称为热降频。
不过，苹果此前为iPhone Duo设计了专门的散热方案，因此不能仅凭折叠屏结构就认定其散热能力不如iPhone 18 Pro。要判断两者在持续负载下的实际差异，还需要等待更完整的测试，包括长时间CPU压力测试、GPU测试、游戏帧率以及温度变化等数据。
此次跑分还有一个值得注意的地方：iPhone Duo的成绩虽然与iPhone 18 Pro系列接近，但没有达到该系列在Geekbench数据库中出现过的最高水平。这并不一定意味着新机性能较弱，因为不同测试之间可能受到设备温度、电量状态、后台进程和软件版本等因素影响。目前只有一组iPhone Duo测试结果，无法据此判断其性能上限。
从产品定位来看，苹果显然希望iPhone Duo不仅是一款具有新形态的手机，也能够保持旗舰级计算性能。折叠屏带来的优势不仅是屏幕面积增加，还包括在同一设备上运行两个应用、处理文档、浏览网页以及进行更复杂的多任务操作。处理器和内存配置如果明显落后于旗舰直板机，将限制这些功能的发挥。
苹果此前已经确认，iPhone Duo将于10月16日开启预购，并于10月23日正式上市。随着开售日期临近，更多零售设备的性能测试预计将陆续出现，届时才能对这款手机的实际表现作出更全面的判断。
总体而言，这次Geekbench跑分至少说明，iPhone Duo在CPU配置和初步计算性能方面没有明显偏离iPhone 18 Pro系列。A20 Pro芯片、六核心CPU、七核心GPU以及12GB运行内存，为其多任务处理和大型应用运行提供了较强的硬件基础。
但单次跑分仍然只是性能评估的起点。对于消费者而言，真正值得关注的还包括双屏同时使用时的流畅程度、游戏性能、散热表现、电池续航，以及折叠屏软件生态是否足够成熟。随着iPhone Duo正式上市，这些问题将比单一的跑分数字更能决定它能否成为一款成功的旗舰折叠屏手机。

evidence.discovery_lead: The iPhone Duo unsurprisingly offers performance similar to the iPhone 18 Pro , according to an early iPhone Duo benchmark shared on Geekbench 7. Both devices are equipped with Apple's 2nm A20 Pro chip with a 6-core CPU and a 7-core GPU. The benchmarked ‌iPhone Duo‌ (iPhone19,4) is running iOS 27.1, as expected, and it had a single-core score of 3986 and a multi-core score of 11067. That's in line with multiple benchmarks collected from ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max models. Scores vary from test to test, so while the result does fall short of the top ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ benchmark scores, we're only viewing a single score. The ‌iPhone Duo‌ has the same 6-core CPU with a 4.93GHz base frequency that's identified in ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ benchmarks, and it lists 11.30GB memory, which means 12GB of RAM. While the ‌iPhone Duo‌ and ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models use the same A20 Pro chip, there could be differences in real-world performance based on thermal management, the ‌iPhone Duo‌'s two screens vs. a single screen, and other factors. Apple says the A20 Pro offers up to 20 percent faster CPU performance than the A19 Pro and up to 40 percent faster GPU performance. GPU speeds were not tested. Pre-orders for the ‌iPhone Duo‌ will start on October 16, and a launch will follow on October 23. evidence.discovery_lead: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo asks buyers to pay more for a folding screen while accepting almost 40 compromises compared with the iPhone 18 Pro and ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max, spanning camera capabilities, everyday usability, and ownership costs. At equivalent storage capacities, the ‌iPhone Duo‌ costs $800 more than the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and $700 more than the Pro Max. Its main attraction is a radically different design: a 5.4-inch outer display opens into a 7.6-inch inner display, providing more space for reading and viewing content, with the ability to use apps side by side. All three devices share a number of key features, including the A20 Pro chip, ProMotion displays with refresh rates up to 120Hz, a 48-megapixel Ultra Wide camera, MagSafe , and USB-C with USB 3 speeds. However, choosing the foldable means giving up some familiar features and accepting differences in how the phone feels, works, and fits into a daily routine. General Compromises The general compromises concern the phone's controls, displays, dimensions, battery life, and cost. Some change interactions that iPhone owners perform throughout the day, while others affect particular preferences or longer-term ownership expenses. When choosing the ‌iPhone Duo‌ over an ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ or Pro Max, users must be prepared to give up: Face ID : Facial authentication is replaced by Touch ID in the side button, changing how users unlock their phone and authenticate purchases and apps. The Action button : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ drops the customizable button used for functions such as Silent mode, the flashlight, Focus modes, and Shortcuts. Camera Control remains available, but there is no dedicated physical mute control. MagSafe wallet compatibility : Apple lists ‌MagSafe‌ cases and wireless chargers as compatible with the ‌iPhone Duo‌, but omits the wallet compatibility it lists for the Pro models due to the device's shape. Physical SIM support in some markets : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ is eSIM-only worldwide. Pro models sold in markets such as the UK and Australia retain a nano-SIM slot, giving buyers the option of using physical SIM cards. A larger screen without unfolding : The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s outer display measures 5.4 inches, compared with 6.3 inches on the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and 6.9 inches on the Pro Max. Accessing its larger 7.6-inch screen requires opening the device. The Pro displays' pixel density on the larger screen : The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s inner display has a density of 430 pixels per inch, compared with 460 ppi on both Pro models. Its outer display retains 460 ppi. A crease-free display : The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s folding screen has a crease that remains visible in certain lighting , despite Apple's efforts to minimize it. The Pro models have a conventional display without a fold through the center. Simpler display maintenance : The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s outer screen has Ceramic Shield 2, while the inner screen uses a different construction with a polymer cover layer. That layer is replaceable if it wears or becomes damaged, introducing an additional service item absent from the Pro models. In the U.S., a cover-layer replacement costs $49 without AppleCare + coverage or $19 with coverage. A thinner, narrower, and lighter phone : Although shorter when closed, the ‌iPhone Duo‌ is 84.1mm wide and 11.3mm thick, compared with widths of 71.9mm and 78mm and a thickness of 8.75mm on the Pro models. At 254 grams, it is also 43 grams heavier than the Pro and five grams heavier than the Pro Max. The Pro Max's longer typical-use battery life : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ is rated for up to 24 hours of typical use, matching the smaller Pro but falling short of the Pro Max's 30 hours. Longer video playback when using the larger display : With its inner screen, the ‌iPhone Duo‌ is rated for up to 31 hours of video playback and 26 hours of streaming, compared with 36 and 33 hours on the Pro and 45 and 40 hours on the Pro Max. Using the outer display improves those figures to 44 and 37 hours, exceeding the smaller Pro's ratings. Faster wired charging : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ reaches up to 50% charge in around 20 minutes, compared with around 15 minutes on both Pro models. Higher sustained-performance : Apple quotes up to 35% better sustained performance than the iPhone 17 Pro for the ‌iPhone Duo‌, compared with up to 40% for the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models. More color choices : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ comes in Night Sky and Star White. The Pro models offer Black, Silver, Glacier, and Burgundy. A higher proportion of recycled content : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ contains 35% recycled content, compared with 40% on the Pro models. A lower purchase price : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ costs $800 more than the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and $700 more than the Pro Max at equivalent storage capacities. Its $1,999 starting price buys 256GB, while a 1TB Pro Max costs $1,899. Lower single-device AppleCare premiums : In the U.S., ‌AppleCare‌+ with Theft and Loss costs $19.99 per month or $199.99 annually for the ‌iPhone Duo‌, compared with $14.99 per month or $149.99 annually for either Pro model. Lower covered screen-repair fees : Under U.S. ‌AppleCare‌ coverage, accidental damage to the ‌iPhone Duo‌'s inner display carries a $99 service fee , compared with $29 for screen-only damage on the Pro models. The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s outer-display damage fee remains $29. Lower repair fees without AppleCare+ coverage : Apple's U.S. estimates include $999 for inner-display damage , compared with screen-repair fees of $329 for the Pro and $379 for the Pro Max. "Other damage" is estimated at $1,499, compared with $849 and $899 respectively. Back-glass repair is also more expensive, at $199 rather than $159 for either Pro model. Lower battery replacement costs : Apple's U.S. out-of-warranty battery service fee is $229 for the ‌iPhone Duo‌, compared with $129 for either Pro model. These differences vary considerably in importance. Losing Face ID or the Action button may be more disruptive to an established routine than having fewer color choices, while the wider, thicker body is something buyers will encounter every time they pick up the closed phone. Buyers moving from a Pro Max also need to consider whether the larger inner display is worth giving up its longer typical-use battery life. The financial differences extend beyond the initial purchase. Higher ‌AppleCare‌ premiums, repair fees, and battery replacement costs can increase the expense of owning the ‌iPhone Duo‌ over several years, so buyers should consider how they intend to maintain and protect the device alongside its purchase price. Camera and Capture Compromises The camera compromises range from fewer zoom options and simpler front cameras to the loss of professional capture formats. Some affect everyday photography, while others matter primarily to users with specific editing and production workflows. When buying the ‌iPhone Duo‌ over an ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ or Pro Max, customers must be prepared to forgo: A dedicated Telephoto camera : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ lacks the Pro models' 48-megapixel 4x Telephoto camera, including its tetraprism design and 3D sensor-shift stabilization, and the 12-megapixel optical-quality 8x crop it enables. Its longest optical-quality zoom setting is a 2x crop from the Main camera. Digital photo zoom tops out at 10x rather than 40x, while video zoom reaches 6x rather than 24x. A variable aperture : The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s Main camera has a fixed f/1.6 aperture. The Pro models offer f/1.48, f/1.8, f/2.8, and f/4.0 settings, giving users more control over light capture and depth of field. The Pro Main camera's stabilization and focusing hardware : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ uses sensor-shift optical image stabilization and Hybrid Focus Pixels, compared with second-generation sensor-shift stabilization and 100% Focus Pixels on the Pro models. Wider Main-camera framing : The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s Main camera has a 26mm equivalent focal length rather than 24mm, producing a slightly tighter view. Its 2x crop is also tighter, at 52mm rather than 48mm. A LiDAR Scanner : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ omits the depth-sensing hardware available on both Pro models for photography, augmented reality, and scanning experiences. Adaptive True Tone flash : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ has a standard True Tone flash instead of the Pro models' adaptive version. Pro Controls : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ does not have the Pro models' full suite of aperture, shutter speed, white balance, and histogram controls. ProRAW photography : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ does not offer Apple's ProRAW capture, including on its front camera. Apple Reference Image capture : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ cannot capture the signed reference images used to help establish whether a photo has been altered. Spatial photos and videos : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ cannot capture spatial photos or spatial video. Both Pro models support spatial video recording at 1080p at 30 fps. ProRes and ProRes RAW recording : These professional video formats are unavailable in the ‌iPhone Duo‌'s native camera feature set, including for front-facing capture. The Pro models support ProRes recording up to 4K at 120 fps from the rear camera and 4K at 60 fps from the front camera with external recording. Apple Log 2 and ACES : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ omits Apple Log 2 and Academy Color Encoding System support for rear and front-camera recording, limiting the professional color workflows otherwise available on the Pro models. Genlock : The ‌iPhone Duo‌ lacks the Pro models' support for synchronizing video capture with other cameras using supported accessories. Studio-quality four-mic array : Apple specifies four studio-quality microphones for the Pro models, but does not list the same specification for the ‌iPhone Duo‌. The foldable still supports Spatial Audio recording, wind noise reduction, and Audio Mix. A higher-resolution outer front camera : The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s outer Center Stage camera is 12 megapixels with a smaller f/2.2 aperture, compared with 18 megapixels and f/1.9 on the Pro models. A fully featured front camera when unfolded : The inner under-display camera is limited to 1080p video at 30 or 60 fps and lacks Night mode, portrait photography, and Photographic Styles. The Pro models' front camera supports 4K Dolby Vision recording and these photography features. The missing Telephoto camera is a practical limitation even for buyers who never use professional formats, since it reduces the options for photographing subjects they cannot get close to. The variable aperture adds another form of control over how a scene is captured. For users who already rely on ProRAW, ProRes, or Log recording, the ‌iPhone Duo‌ also changes what they can capture and how they can edit it afterward. Are the Compromises Worth It? The ‌iPhone Duo‌ can justify these compromises if its inner display meaningfully improves things you already do on your phone. Reading long articles, reviewing documents, comparing information in two apps, editing photos, or watching video could all become much more comfortable with a larger screen. If those are activities you would regularly unfold the device for, its defining feature could be more valuable to you than several of the capabilities it lacks. It is therefore important for prospective customers to assess what they plan to use the ‌iPhone Duo‌'s internal display for and how often they would do so. A handful of activities you repeat throughout the day makes a stronger case for the foldable than an occasional task you would usually handle on an iPad or Mac. Hands-on demo time should also be helpful, and include time using the phone closed. Check whether you are comfortable with its width, thickness, weight, outer display, and ‌Touch ID‌ button, then unfold it and try the activities you expect to benefit from the larger screen. The device needs to suit both the quick interactions that make up much of phone use and the longer sessions that take advantage of its inner display. The large number of compromises alone should not determine your decision. If you never record ProRes video, losing it may have no consequence, while giving up a telephoto camera you use every day could be decisive. There is also value in being enthusiastic about Apple's radically new take on the iPhone. Wanting to explore a folding design and new ways of using familiar apps is a reasonable part of the buying decision, even without a specific productivity benefit. The ‌iPhone Duo‌ makes the most sense for buyers who expect to use its inner display frequently, enjoy adapting to the new form factor, and are comfortable with the features and money they give up to get it. For buyers who expect to spend most of their time on the outer display, or who place greater importance on camera versatility, the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models may be a stronger fit at a lower price. ‌iPhone Duo‌ pre-orders open on Friday, October 16, with availability starting on October 23. "Other damage" is estimated at $1,499, compared with $849 and $899 respectively. Back-glass repair is also more expensive, at $199 rather than $159 for either Pro model.
Lower battery replacement costs: Apple's U.S. out-of-warranty battery service fee is $229 for the ‌iPhone Duo‌, compared with $129 for either Pro model.

These differences vary considerably in importance. Losing Face ID or the Action button may be more disruptive to an established routine than having fewer color choices, while the wider, thicker body is something buyers will encounter every time they pick up the closed phone. Buyers moving from a Pro Max also need to consider whether the larger inner display is worth giving up its longer typical-use battery life.

The financial differences extend beyond the initial purchase. Higher ‌AppleCare‌ premiums, repair fees, and battery replacement costs can increase the expense of owning the ‌iPhone Duo‌ over several years, so buyers should consider how they intend to maintain and protect the device alongside its purchase price.
Camera and Capture Compromises

The camera compromises range from fewer zoom options and simpler front cameras to the loss of professional capture formats. Some affect everyday photography, while others matter primarily to users with specific editing and production workflows. When buying the ‌iPhone Duo‌ over an ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ or Pro Max, customers must be prepared to forgo:

A dedicated Telephoto camera: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ lacks the Pro models' 48-megapixel 4x Telephoto camera, including its tetraprism design and 3D sensor-shift stabilization, and the 12-megapixel optical-quality 8x crop it enables. Its longest optical-quality zoom setting is a 2x crop from the Main camera. Digital photo zoom tops out at 10x rather than 40x, while video zoom reaches 6x rather than 24x.

A variable aperture: The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s Main camera has a fixed f/1.6 aperture. The Pro models offer f/1.48, f/1.8, f/2.8, and f/4.0 settings, giving users more control over light capture and depth of field.

The Pro Main camera's stabilization and focusing hardware: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ uses sensor-shift optical image stabilization and Hybrid Focus Pixels, compared with second-generation sensor-shift stabilization and 100% Focus Pixels on the Pro models.

Wider Main-camera framing: The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s Main camera has a 26mm equivalent focal length rather than 24mm, producing a slightly tighter view. Its 2x crop is also tighter, at 52mm rather than 48mm.
A LiDAR Scanner: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ omits the depth-sensing hardware available on both Pro models for photography, augmented reality, and scanning experiences.
Adaptive True Tone flash: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ has a standard True Tone flash instead of the Pro models' adaptive version.
Pro Controls: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ does not have the Pro models' full suite of aperture, shutter speed, white balance, and histogram controls.
ProRAW photography: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ does not offer Apple's ProRAW capture, including on its front camera.
Apple Reference Image capture: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ cannot capture the signed reference images used to help establish whether a photo has been altered.
Spatial photos and videos: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ cannot capture spatial photos or spatial video. Both Pro models support spatial video recording at 1080p at 30 fps.

ProRes and ProRes RAW recording: These professional video formats are unavailable in the ‌iPhone Duo‌'s native camera feature set, including for front-facing capture. The Pro models support ProRes recording up to 4K at 120 fps from the rear camera and 4K at 60 fps from the front camera with external recording.

Apple Log 2 and ACES: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ omits Apple Log 2 and Academy Color Encoding System support for rear and front-camera recording, limiting the professional color workflows otherwise available on the Pro models.
Genlock: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ lacks the Pro models' support for synchronizing video capture with other cameras using supported accessories.

Studio-quality four-mic array: Apple specifies four studio-quality microphones for the Pro models, but does not list the same specification for the ‌iPhone Duo‌. The foldable still supports Spatial Audio recording, wind noise reduction, and Audio Mix.
A higher-resolution outer front camera: The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s outer Center Stage camera is 12 megapixels with a smaller f/2.2 aperture, compared with 18 megapixels and f/1.9 on the Pro models.

A fully featured front camera when unfolded: The inner under-display camera is limited to 1080p video at 30 or 60 fps and lacks Night mode, portrait photography, and Photographic Styles. The Pro models' front camera supports 4K Dolby Vision recording and these photography features.

The missing Telephoto camera is a practical limitation even for buyers who never use professional formats, since it reduces the options for photographing subjects they cannot get close to. The variable aperture adds another form of control over how a scene is captured. For users who already rely on ProRAW, ProRes, or Log recording, the ‌iPhone Duo‌ also changes what they can capture and how they can edit it afterward.
Are the Compromises Worth It?

The ‌iPhone Duo‌ can justify these compromises if its inner display meaningfully improves things you already do on your phone. Reading long articles, reviewing documents, comparing information in two apps, editing photos, or watching video could all become much more comfortable with a larger screen. If those are activities you would regularly unfold the device for, its defining feature could be more valuable to you than several of the capabilities it lacks.

It is therefore important for prospective customers to assess what they plan to use the ‌iPhone Duo‌'s internal display for and how often they would do so. A handful of activities you repeat throughout the day makes a stronger case for the foldable than an occasional task you would usually handle on an iPad or Mac.

Hands-on demo time should also be helpful, and include time using the phone closed. Check whether you are comfortable with its width, thickness, weight, outer display, and ‌Touch ID‌ button, then unfold it and try the activities you expect to benefit from the larger screen. The device needs to suit both the quick interactions that make up much of phone use and the longer sessions that take advantage of its inner display.

The large number of compromises alone should not determine your decision. If you never record ProRes video, losing it may have no consequence, while giving up a telephoto camera you use every day could be decisive.

There is also value in being enthusiastic about Apple's radically new take on the iPhone. Wanting to explore a folding design and new ways of using familiar apps is a reasonable part of the buying decision, even without a specific productivity benefit.

The ‌iPhone Duo‌ makes the most sense for buyers who expect to use its inner display frequently, enjoy adapting to the new form factor, and are comfortable with the features and money they give up to get it. For buyers who expect to spend most of their time on the outer display, or who place greater importance on camera versatility, the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models may be a stronger fit at a lower price.
‌iPhone Duo‌ pre-orders open on Friday, October 16, with availability starting on October 23.

All three devices share a number of key features, including the A20 Pro chip, ProMotion displays with refresh rates up to 120Hz, a 48-megapixel Ultra Wide camera, MagSafe, and USB-C with USB 3 speeds. However, choosing the foldable means giving up some familiar features and accepting differences in how the phone feels, works, and fits into a daily routine.

The general compromises concern the phone's controls, displays, dimensions, battery life, and cost. Some change interactions that iPhone owners perform throughout the day, while others affect particular preferences or longer-term ownership expenses. When choosing the ‌iPhone Duo‌ over an ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ or Pro Max, users must be prepared to give up:
Face ID: Facial authentication is replaced by Touch ID in the side button, changing how users unlock their phone and authenticate purchases and apps.

The Action button: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ drops the customizable button used for functions such as Silent mode, the flashlight, Focus modes, and Shortcuts. Camera Control remains available, but there is no dedicated physical mute control.

MagSafe wallet compatibility: Apple lists ‌MagSafe‌ cases and wireless chargers as compatible with the ‌iPhone Duo‌, but omits the wallet compatibility it lists for the Pro models due to the device's shape.

Physical SIM support in some markets: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ is eSIM-only worldwide. Pro models sold in markets such as the UK and Australia retain a nano-SIM slot, giving buyers the option of using physical SIM cards.

A larger screen without unfolding: The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s outer display measures 5.4 inches, compared with 6.3 inches on the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and 6.9 inches on the Pro Max. Accessing its larger 7.6-inch screen requires opening the device.

The Pro displays' pixel density on the larger screen: The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s inner display has a density of 430 pixels per inch, compared with 460 ppi on both Pro models. Its outer display retains 460 ppi.

A crease-free display: The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s folding screen has a crease that remains visible in certain lighting, despite Apple's efforts to minimize it. The Pro models have a conventional display without a fold through the center.

Simpler display maintenance: The ‌iPhone Duo‌'s outer screen has Ceramic Shield 2, while the inner screen uses a different construction with a polymer cover layer. That layer is replaceable if it wears or becomes damaged, introducing an additional service item absent from the Pro models. In the U.S., a cover-layer replacement costs $49 without AppleCare+ coverage or $19 with coverage.

A thinner, narrower, and lighter phone: Although shorter when closed, the ‌iPhone Duo‌ is 84.1mm wide and 11.3mm thick, compared with widths of 71.9mm and 78mm and a thickness of 8.75mm on the Pro models. At 254 grams, it is also 43 grams heavier than the Pro and five grams heavier than the Pro Max.
The Pro Max's longer typical-use battery life: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ is rated for up to 24 hours of typical use, matching the smaller Pro but falling short of the Pro Max's 30 hours.

Longer video playback when using the larger display: With its inner screen, the ‌iPhone Duo‌ is rated for up to 31 hours of video playback and 26 hours of streaming, compared with 36 and 33 hours on the Pro and 45 and 40 hours on the Pro Max. Using the outer display improves those figures to 44 and 37 hours, exceeding the smaller Pro's ratings.
Faster wired charging: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ reaches up to 50% charge in around 20 minutes, compared with around 15 minutes on both Pro models.
Higher sustained-performance: Apple quotes up to 35% better sustained performance than the iPhone 17 Pro for the ‌iPhone Duo‌, compared with up to 40% for the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models.
More color choices: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ comes in Night Sky and Star White. The Pro models offer Black, Silver, Glacier, and Burgundy.
A higher proportion of recycled content: The ‌iPhone Duo‌ contains 35% recycled content, compared with 40% on the Pro models.

units.text: OpenAI与苹果之间围绕商业机密的法律纠纷出现新进展。OpenAI近日向法院提交文件称，公司自身也是商业机密盗取事件的受害者，并暗示苹果近年来推进的人工智能硬件项目可能受到相关机密信息泄露事件的影响。
根据OpenAI的说法，在配合苹果发起的商业机密诉讼调查过程中，公司发现一名员工涉嫌将OpenAI内部资料带回苹果。这名员工原本在苹果任职，之后加入OpenAI工作约六个月，并于2026年重返苹果。
OpenAI指出，这名员工在离职时保留了一款尚未发布硬件设备的相关资料，这些内容被存放在个人账户中。相关文件据称包括产品图片、工程设计信息、供应商资料、制造数据以及外观处理和密封材料等技术规范。
OpenAI认为，这起事件与苹果此前指控前员工窃取商业机密的性质十分相似。公司还试图将这些泄露信息与苹果的HomeView产品联系起来，认为部分信息可能对苹果的AI硬件布局产生了影响。
在法庭文件中，OpenAI表示，相关演示活动似乎在数月前已经发生，并称苹果在获得这些信息后，正在加大对人工智能产品领域的投入力度。
OpenAI还声称，该员工曾向苹果亚洲业务运营部门的一位副总裁介绍过相关产品规划，并表示已经就此问题向苹果方面提出关切。
对于这些指控，苹果方面予以否认。苹果表示，没有证据表明相关窃密行为或信息汇报事件曾经发生。与此同时，苹果在接受媒体采访时强调，公司拥有完善的管理政策和流程，以确保新员工不会使用来自OpenAI或其他公司的机密信息。
值得注意的是，OpenAI在文件中没有公开这名涉嫌泄密员工的身份，这在类似案件中并不常见。
此次指控的背景是苹果于2026年7月发起的一起商业机密诉讼。苹果当时指控两名前员工Tang Yew Tan和Chang Liu在离职后非法获取并保留苹果的商业机密，随后相关信息被用于帮助OpenAI获益。
苹果称，两人在离开公司后仍继续使用苹果提供的设备和服务获取内部资料，并涉嫌利用系统漏洞访问信息、向个人账户发送供应链数据，以及要求有意加入OpenAI的苹果员工携带尚未发布的硬件产品参加面试。
基于这些指控，苹果于今年7月同时起诉了涉事前员工及OpenAI。OpenAI则始终否认相关说法，并表示公司内部设有防范商业机密泄露和不当使用竞争对手信息的制度。
过去数月里，双方围绕商业机密问题持续展开法律攻防。最新消息显示，负责审理案件的法官已部分批准苹果提出的信息披露请求，允许苹果获取与涉事员工有关的部分OpenAI资料。案件正式开庭时间目前尚未确定，但随着双方相互提出新的指控，这场备受关注的企业法律纠纷预计仍将持续升级。

evidence.discovery_lead: In a new filing, OpenAI claims that it too was victimized by confidential information theft, and implies that Apple's HomeView was somehow influenced by that theft. Apple will get some of the OpenAI documents it requested in court. Without much detail, OpenAI says that during the forensic investigation that is required by Apple's trade secret theft lawsuit, it discovered trade theft by Apple. In a filing on Wednesday, the company vaguely says that the thief joined OpenAI from Apple, worked at OpenAI for six months, then returned to Apple. When the alleged thief returned to Apple, they brought with them details of one OpenAI hardware device stashed away in personal accounts. Furthermore, the documents include specific images, engineering info, supplier information, manufacturing data, and standards for cosmetic finishes and sealants. units.text: 苹果正在进一步加强Mac与HomePod生态之间的整合。根据最新信息，只要用户拥有支持Wi‑Fi 6E的Mac，以及较新的HomePod设备，Mac上的所有声音，包括系统提示音和通知音，都可以直接通过HomePod播放。
这一功能随着苹果近期发布新一代HomePod mini 2而受到关注。新产品搭载S10芯片，并新增多项功能，其中之一就是允许扬声器作为Mac的系统级音频输出设备使用。这意味着它不再只是通过AirPlay播放音乐，而是能够承担类似传统电脑扬声器的角色。
事实上，这项能力此前已经支持第二代大型HomePod。如今，苹果将其扩展到新发布的HomePod mini 2，使更多用户能够利用智能音箱作为Mac的主要音频设备。
用户既可以连接单个HomePod，也可以组建立体声组合。对于桌面空间有限的用户而言，体积更小的HomePod mini 2显然更适合作为日常电脑扬声器使用，而大型HomePod组成的立体声系统则能够提供更强劲的声音表现。
HomePod mini 2还加入了名为“Sound Glow”的新特性。当用户播放音乐时，扬声器顶部的灯光会随节奏律动，并根据当前专辑封面的主色调自动调整显示效果，从而带来更具沉浸感的视觉体验。
不过，并非所有Mac都支持这项新功能。苹果要求设备必须具备Wi‑Fi 6E支持。目前符合条件的机型包括：2023年及之后推出的MacBook Pro、2024年及之后推出的MacBook Air、MacBook Neo，以及2023年及之后推出的iMac、Mac mini、Mac Studio和Mac Pro。
这一时间节点并非巧合。2023年开始，苹果在M3系列处理器平台上逐步引入Wi‑Fi 6E支持，因此大部分兼容设备都来自这一时期之后。
在HomePod方面，可作为Mac系统音频输出设备的产品目前包括2023款第二代HomePod以及2026款HomePod mini 2。
苹果新近发布的HomeView虽然内置扬声器，且在功能定位上与HomePod较为接近，但暂时无法充当Mac的系统音频输出设备。不过，它依然支持AirPlay，因此用户仍可将音乐、视频等媒体内容无线投送到HomeView进行播放。
按照苹果的设计，这项功能将在Mac的“系统设置”中的“声音”选项下进行管理和配置。不过截至10月14日，该功能似乎尚未在macOS Golden Gate正式启用。外界预计，随着HomePod mini 2于10月30日正式发售，相关支持可能会通过后续软件更新一并开放。
对于苹果用户来说，这意味着HomePod正在从单纯的智能音箱逐渐发展为Mac生态的重要组成部分。未来，无论是观看影片、进行FaceTime通话、视频会议，还是处理日常工作，都可以直接通过HomePod获得更统一、更高质量的无线音频体验。

这一时间节点并非巧合。2023年开始，苹果在M3系列处理器平台上逐步引入Wi‑Fi 6E支持，因此大部分兼容设备都来自这一时期之后。
在HomePod方面，可作为Mac系统音频输出设备的产品目前包括2023款第二代HomePod以及2026款HomePod mini 2。
苹果新近发布的HomeView虽然内置扬声器，且在功能定位上与HomePod较为接近，但暂时无法充当Mac的系统音频输出设备。不过，它依然支持AirPlay，因此用户仍可将音乐、视频等媒体内容无线投送到HomeView进行播放。
按照苹果的设计，这项功能将在Mac的“系统设置”中的“声音”选项下进行管理和配置。不过截至10月14日，该功能似乎尚未在macOS Golden Gate正式启用。外界预计，随着HomePod mini 2于10月30日正式发售，相关支持可能会通过后续软件更新一并开放。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，科技媒体 MacRumors 今天（10 月 15 日）发布博文，报道称苹果首款智能家居中枢 HomeView 内置温度和湿度传感器，可以监测室内状况，并将读数共享给 LG 电子和施耐德电气的新型恒温器。
根据苹果官方补充说明，HomeView 能够实时监测室内的温度和湿度变化，联动“苹果智能家居收藏系列”（Apple Home Collection）相关配件，同步家庭环境数据。
HomeView 还可以借助 iPhone 的端侧 AI 算力，启动“自适应温度”（Adaptive Temperature）功能，根据家中是否有人、夜间作息等场景，全自动调整全屋的空调与新风系统，省去了传统智能家居繁琐的定时设置。
IT之家翻译苹果官方相关说明如下：
温度和湿度传感功能针对室内家庭环境优化，环境温度约为 15℃ 至 30℃，相对湿度约为 30% 至 70%。在长时间高音量播放音频的情况下，精度可能会降低。启动后需要一些时间校准传感器，之后才能显示结果。

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple plans to launch the HomeView on November 13, so we have a month to go until we can learn more about it. Right now, we're limited to the information Apple has shared and what members of the media learned during limited hands-on time. We've rounded up some interesting HomeView tidbits you might have missed. Recipe walkthroughs - HomeView makes Safari recipes easier to follow by pulling out the ingredients and steps. You can tap on a "Start Cooking" button to get step-by-step instructions you can use as you cook. The device also supports multiple voice-activated timers. Siri access - You can say Siri (English only) or Hey ‌Siri‌ for hands-free access, but there are also options for activating ‌Siri‌ with a swipe down from the top of the display or using Type to ‌Siri‌. Apple Intelligence - HomeView has some Apple Intelligence features built in. You or members of your household can use ‌Siri‌ AI for general knowledge questions if you don't have an ‌Apple Intelligence‌ iPhone or iPad , but you do need one for any requests involving personal context. Guests - Personal data is private, but guests can control smart home accessories, check the weather, set timers, and play music. Visitors can also AirPlay audio to the HomeView using peer-to-peer discovery. Adaptable interface - HomeView can tell when someone is approaching and parts of the interface will change based on proximity. If someone is across the room, it shows less information in a larger view. As the person approaches, the view can change to show more information. Faces - HomeView has multiple customizable faces similar to watch faces. Apple says some faces can "wake with you in the morning, wind down with you at night." The Snoopy face, for example, has different animations based on time of day, weather, and holidays. Third-party apps - There's no App Store , but the HomeView has CarPlay-like software capabilities. It can show CarPlay audio and video apps from a linked iPhone. There are no ‌CarPlay‌ video apps except for Apple TV , so app developers will need to add support. Handoff - You can transfer songs, podcasts, calls, videos, and recipes from the iPhone to the HomeView. Live Activities - HomeView supports Live Activities, so if you have a timer running or get an incoming Intercom message, content will be visible while you use other apps. Sensors and HomeKit - The HomeView has temperature and humidity sensors that can be used in Home app scenes and automations. It also serves as a home hub for controlling HomeKit and Matter devices when you're away from home. HomeView is available for pre-order now, and it will launch on November 13. It is priced at $299 and comes in either a tabletop version with a speaker base or a wall-mounted version. units.text: 10 HomeView Features You Might Have Missed

Apple plans to launch the HomeView on November 13, so we have a month to go until we can learn more about it. Right now, we're limited to the information Apple has shared and what members of the media learned during limited hands-on time.
We've rounded up some interesting HomeView tidbits you might have missed.

Recipe walkthroughs - HomeView makes Safari recipes easier to follow by pulling out the ingredients and steps. You can tap on a "Start Cooking" button to get step-by-step instructions you can use as you cook. The device also supports multiple voice-activated timers.

Siri access - You can say Siri (English only) or Hey ‌Siri‌ for hands-free access, but there are also options for activating ‌Siri‌ with a swipe down from the top of the display or using Type to ‌Siri‌.

Apple Intelligence - HomeView has some Apple Intelligence features built in. You or members of your household can use ‌Siri‌ AI for general knowledge questions if you don't have an ‌Apple Intelligence‌ iPhone or iPad, but you do need one for any requests involving personal context.

Guests - Personal data is private, but guests can control smart home accessories, check the weather, set timers, and play music. Visitors can also AirPlay audio to the HomeView using peer-to-peer discovery.

Adaptable interface - HomeView can tell when someone is approaching and parts of the interface will change based on proximity. If someone is across the room, it shows less information in a larger view. As the person approaches, the view can change to show more information.

Faces - HomeView has multiple customizable faces similar to watch faces. Apple says some faces can "wake with you in the morning, wind down with you at night." The Snoopy face, for example, has different animations based on time of day, weather, and holidays.

Third-party apps - There's no App Store, but the HomeView has CarPlay-like software capabilities. It can show CarPlay audio and video apps from a linked iPhone. There are no ‌CarPlay‌ video apps except for Apple TV, so app developers will need to add support.
Handoff - You can transfer songs, podcasts, calls, videos, and recipes from the iPhone to the HomeView.
Live Activities - HomeView supports Live Activities, so if you have a timer running or get an incoming Intercom message, content will be visible while you use other apps.

Sensors and HomeKit - The HomeView has temperature and humidity sensors that can be used in Home app scenes and automations. It also serves as a home hub for controlling HomeKit and Matter devices when you're away from home.
HomeView is available for pre-order now, and it will launch on November 13. It is priced at $299 and comes in either a tabletop version with a speaker base or a wall-mounted version.

乔布斯在信中建议 Hatfield 用这台 Apple I 加 400 美元（现汇率约合 2,682 元人民币），换购一块 Apple II 主板。该细节使这台机器具备罕见的原始史料价值，也成为此次拍卖的重要背景。
原主人 Hatfield 当年以 666.60 美元（现汇率约合 4,470 元人民币）购入这台 Apple I。2013 年，欧洲拍卖行 Breker 曾以约 666,150 美元（现汇率约合 446.7 万元人民币）将其售出；此次成交价较 2013 年上涨约 72.7%。IT之家附上相关图片如下：
Apple I 的拍卖价格近年持续走高。2025 年 3 月，一台 Apple I 以 37.5 万美元（现汇率约合 251.4 万元人民币）成交；同年 9 月，另一台配备原装木壳的 Apple I 以 47.5 万美元（现汇率约合 318.5 万元人民币）成交。
2022 年，Wozniak 曾在一台修复版 Apple I 的 CPU 上签名，该机最终以 340,100 美元（现汇率约合 228 万元人民币）成交。此次“哈特菲尔德”Apple I 的 115 万美元（现汇率约合 771.1 万元人民币）成交价，显著高于近年同类拍品价格区间。

units.text: Apple is rolling out its stunning Detailed City Experience in Apple Maps for users in Austin, TX. This marks a robust overhaul of Apple Maps in Austin, similar to what we’ve seen in other markets like San Francisco, Chicago, and London.

The Apple Maps Detailed City Experience revamp adds in-depth details on elevation, buildings, trees, road features, and key city landmarks. In Austin, that includes the Texas Capitol building, Q2 Stadium, the Blanton Museum of Art, the Paramount Theater, and the iconic Congress Avenue Bridge.

The benefits of the Detailed City Experience in Austin also extend to driving and walking navigation. Apple Maps users in Austin will notice improved navigation guidance, more immersive visuals, and additional road markings. This also applies to Apple Maps in CarPlay.

Additionally, ahead of next week’s Formula 1 United States Grand Prix, Apple is launching a detailed F1 experience for Circuit of the Americas in Austin. Apple has rolled out similar experiences for F1 races around the world this year. This includes detailed circuit maps and 3D landmarks throughout the Circuit of the Americas.
If you’re attending the F1 Grand Prix in person, Apple Maps also shows race-day amenities, navigation, walking directions, and more.

The new Apple Maps features for Austin, TX are rolling out now. You can check them out in the Maps app on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Starting this year, Apple TV subscribers can stream all F1 races at no extra charge.

units.text: No, HomePod Mini 1 Won't Support Siri AI as CNET Reported
Update – 10:30 a.m. Pacific Time: CNET has corrected its article and now says only the HomePod mini 2 will support Siri AI. Original article follows.

Siri AI will apparently not be limited to the new HomePod mini 2, with support also coming to the first-generation HomePod mini in a software update later this year, according to a report today from CNET's Jeff Carlson.

"The HomePod Mini 2 also gets a faster S10 processor, which should help with processing Siri AI requests," he said. "However, the current S5-powered HomePod Mini will also get Siri AI compatibility later this year, along with updates to iOS 27.2."
Fine print on Apple's website does not mention this detail, at least as far as we have seen, so we have reached out to the company for comment.

For the Apple TV 4K, Apple's fine print did mention that Siri AI support will extend back to the second-generation Apple TV 4K from 2021, but we have not found any explicit fine print mention about Siri AI coming to the HomePod mini (1st generation).
Apple said setting up Siri AI on the HomePod mini 2 will require a paired iPhone or iPad model with Apple Intelligence support.

A paired device iPhone or iPad with Apple Intelligence support is also required for any requests involving a user's personal context, according to Apple. However, once Siri AI is enabled on the HomePod mini, the company said that even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad can access Siri AI's broad world knowledge, richer and more natural conversations, and improved music discovery.
HomePod mini 2 launches on Friday, October 30, with pre-orders underway. It has an S10 chip, up from the S5 chip in the previous model.

units.text: 苹果股价于当地时间10月14日收涨0.5%，报每股342.96美元，推动公司市值首次在收盘时突破5万亿美元，达到约5.005万亿美元。此前苹果已多次在盘中短暂越过这一关口，但收盘后回落；今年7月，苹果曾一度盘中达到约5.036万亿美元，成为继英伟达之后第二家触及5万亿美元市值的企业。
截至10月14日收盘，英伟达市值约为5.33万亿美元，仍居全球上市公司首位。苹果曾在今年7月短暂超过英伟达，但随后英伟达重新夺回榜首。市值是股价与流通股数量的乘积，随股价变化而波动，5万亿美元并非公司固定不变的估值。
苹果此次收盘突破发生在新任首席执行官约翰·特纳斯接替Tim Cook一个多月后，也恰逢首款折叠屏iPhone Duo开放预购前两天。时间上的重合并不能单独证明股价上涨由新产品或管理层交接所推动；截至当日，苹果的市值仍与英伟达相差约3250亿美元。

units.text: 快科技10月15日消息，市场研究机构Omdia最新预估数据显示，2026年第三季度全球智能手机出货量同比下降20%，跌幅较第二季度的6%明显扩大。
尽管各大厂商陆续推出旗舰新品，渠道也开始为年末销售旺季备货，但全球智能手机出货量仍出现环比下滑。
内存和存储成本持续上涨是市场下行的重要原因之一，手机厂商利润空间受到挤压，不得不缩减低利润机型的出货规模。
值得注意的是，市场下行进一步加剧了行业两极分化。
三星和苹果合计占据全球45%的智能手机市场份额，较去年同期提升约8个百分点，展现出较强的抗风险能力。
具体排名来看，三星以23%的市场份额稳居全球第一，虽然出货量同比下降，但市场份额仍有所提升。
三星丰富的产品阵容和成熟的全球渠道体系，帮助其缓解了市场下行带来的冲击。
8月上市的Galaxy Z Fold8和Flip8系列，也进一步巩固了其在高端市场的地位。
苹果以22%的市场份额位列第二，与三星仅相差1个百分点。
iPhone 17系列需求持续，9月发布的iPhone 18 Pro系列也帮助苹果保持了市场势头。
此外，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo的推出，进一步丰富了产品阵容，为其开拓折叠屏市场带来了新的机会。
国产厂商中，小米以12%的市场份额稳居全球第三，OPPO（含realme和一加）以9%的份额排名第四，vivo以8%的份额跻身前五。
Omdia指出，随着内存成本持续上涨，各个价位段手机的利润空间均受到挤压，其中对价格更加敏感的入门级产品受到的冲击尤为明显。
为应对成本压力，手机厂商正逐步调整经营策略，不再单纯追求出货规模，而是更加注重提升产品平均售价、优化产品结构，以维持盈利能力。
Omdia预计，进入第四季度后，即使有旗舰新品发布、促销活动和年末购物旺季带动，仍难以完全抵消持续的供应端压力。

units.text: OpenAI claims a former employee took more than 100 files related to its product plans before joining Apple. In a document filed on Wednesday, OpenAI accuses the unnamed employee of sending this information to a personal account and then presenting it to Apple leadership, including the vice president of the company’s operations in Asia.

The filing, reported earlier by Reuters, is tied to a legal battle between Apple and OpenAI over trade secrets — but this time, OpenAI is doing the accusing. It alleges that the files in question contain images of at least one unreleased device, along with supplier information, engineering data, project files, standards for cosmetic finishes, and reports about the “coating and sealing of hardware components.”

OpenAI also links Apple’s new HomeView smart display and the range of other devices it revealed this week to the former employee’s presentation. “That presentation appears to have happened months ago — and now, armed with that information, Apple is making a new push into AI-enabled products,” OpenAI claims, while citing an article and a company announcement about Apple’s new product releases.

Apple’s product plans typically operate on a very long timeline, and its smart display has been rumored for years. Conversely, Apple accuses OpenAI of stealing confidential documents and spying on hardware prototypes to help build its own products.

“OpenAI is very concerned that its trade secret and confidential information is now circulating inside Apple, where Apple engineers can shape Apple’s upcoming products based on OpenAI’s confidential and innovative work,” OpenAI claims. Apple didn’t immediately respond to The Verge’s request for comment.

units.text: Siri AI is a tentpole addition to HomePod mini 2, but a CNET report today originally claimed Siri AI was coming to older HomePod mini models too. However, the story has since been updated with a correction and 9to5Mac received a statement confirming Siri AI will be exclusive to HomePod mini 2.
Apple says Siri AI will be exclusive to HomePod mini 2

Earlier today, CNET published a report saying that Siri AI is coming to the older HomePod mini. It originally claimed: “the current S5-powered HomePod Mini will also get Siri AI compatibility later this year, along with updates to iOS 27.2.”

This news seemed unlikely given there’s no evidence on Apple’s website or press releases of HomePod mini 1 supporting Siri AI. Add to this, Apple did explicitly say that Siri AI will come to certain older Apple TV 4K models, and included no such assurance for HomePod mini owners.
CNET ultimately updated its article with a correction saying that Siri AI won’t come to older HomePods. This aligns with what Apple told 9to5Mac.

Apple confirmed to 9to5Mac that Siri AI will only be available on HomePod mini 2 as well as Apple TV 4K (2nd generation or later).
The first HomePod mini debuted six years ago, so this isn’t surprising news. The S5 chip is very dated for AI tasks, as evidenced by Apple Watch models requiring much newer chips for Siri AI support.

At close of market, Apple's valuation once again passed $342.61, which means it has exceeded $5 trillion. It barely squeaked by, closing at $342.96 or $5.005T. Apple stocks closed at a new record high Back in October 2025, Apple closed at over $4 trillion for the first time, and then on July 28, 2026, it crossed the $5 trillion mark. It wasn't very long before it dipped back under that to be a paltry $4 trillion and change, but now it's back. At close of market, Apple's valuation once again passed $342.61, which means it has exceeded $5 trillion. It barely squeaked by, closing at $342.96 or $5.005T. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

units.text: 苹果计划通过预计于今年12月发布的iOS 27.3更新，将Apple Intelligence（Apple Intelligence）引入中国大陆市场。彭博社报道称，此次推出距离苹果首次发布相关人工智能功能已过去约两年。不过，首批面向中国用户开放的功能将受到一定限制，升级版Siri AI、图像生成工具Image Playground以及新版Genmoji等功能预计不会同步推出，文本生成工具也可能仅提供有限的能力。
如果这一计划最终落实，将意味着Apple Intelligence在中国大陆的落地取得实质性进展。此前，苹果已经在全球多个市场推出相关功能，但由于中国对生成式人工智能服务的监管要求不同，中国大陆用户一直无法正常使用完整的Apple Intelligence功能。随着中国监管部门逐步批准相关服务，以及苹果与中国本土科技企业开展合作，这一局面有望在年底前发生变化。
据《南华早报》10月14日报道，中国工业和信息化部近期向苹果发放了网络接入许可，允许其将阿里巴巴的通义千问（Qwen）和通义万相等模型引入相关iPhone产品，为Apple Intelligence在中国市场正式推出铺平道路。报道称，相关设备包括新款iPhone Duo、iPhone 18 Pro以及此前推出的部分iPhone机型。
苹果最早于2024年推出Apple Intelligence相关功能，并从iOS 18.1开始逐步向用户开放。不过，由于中国大陆对生成式人工智能服务实行特定的监管制度，苹果无法直接将面向其他市场的服务原样引入中国。为了满足当地要求，公司需要与中国本土企业合作，并确保相关模型及服务符合监管规定。
此前，苹果已经与阿里巴巴和百度展开合作，探索在中国市场提供人工智能功能的技术方案。相关合作不仅涉及模型能力，也涉及服务部署、数据处理和持续更新等问题。中国监管部门需要对相关服务进行审批，模型后续更新也可能需要接受持续监管。
与华为、小米、OPPO等已经在手机中提供多种人工智能功能的竞争对手相比，苹果此前在中国市场缺少同等规模的生成式人工智能服务。这种差距不仅影响用户对手机功能的评价，也可能影响消费者在换机时对不同品牌的选择。Apple Intelligence如果能够在中国正式推出，将有助于苹果补齐这一短板，并增强iPhone在中国市场的竞争力。
不过，首批功能预计不会涵盖苹果在其他市场已经推出的全部人工智能体验。报道指出，升级版Siri AI将暂时缺席，Image Playground和新版Genmoji也不会同步提供，文本生成工具的功能范围同样受到限制。这意味着，中国用户即使在年底获得Apple Intelligence，也不一定能够使用海外版本的全部功能。
这类限制反映了苹果在中国市场面临的双重挑战：一方面，公司需要满足本地监管要求；另一方面，还必须在功能体验、模型能力和服务更新方面与全球版本保持尽可能一致。由于中国大陆对人工智能服务的监管要求与其他地区不同，苹果需要针对当地市场制定专门的技术方案。
值得注意的是，目前有关发布时间和具体功能范围的信息主要来自媒体报道，苹果尚未正式公布中国大陆版Apple Intelligence的完整上线安排。iOS 27.3预计于12月推出，但最终发布日期、支持机型以及实际开放的功能仍可能发生变化。
如果苹果能够按照计划在年底前推出首批服务，中国大陆用户将首次有机会在iPhone上使用一系列官方整合的生成式人工智能功能。不过，考虑到Siri AI及部分图像生成能力预计仍将缺席，首发版本更可能是一个经过本地化调整的基础版本，而非与海外市场完全一致的完整体验。
